title: Senior Software Engineer - Session Replay | USA | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are looking for candidates in the USA time zones.

Senior Software Engineer - Session Replay

The Opportunity:

The Session Replay squad is building a new Grafana Cloud product that helps our customers to understand what users actually experienced when something goes wrong.

Session Replay connects frontend signals (errors, performance, synthetic checks) to concrete session-level evidence, enabling faster and more confident investigation of production issues.

This team works at the intersection of:

• frontend observability,

• backend data processing and storage at scale,

• debugging workflows across products,

• privacy and access control,

• performance and cost constraints at scale.

Session Replay is still early, which means you’ll help shape both what we build and how it fits into Grafana Cloud. A key part of our next phase is evolving the backend architecture of capturing sessions, including a migration toward columnar/analytical solution as a primary storage and query engine for high-volume session data.

As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software. We are looking for Senior Software Engineers who are passionate about working with data and providing seamless experiences for our customers to join our growing team! Our stack is Golang, Typescript and React, but we build tools for people using many other stacks. 

What You’ll Be Doing:

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will operate as a technical leader and systems thinker, driving both product direction and architectural evolution, specifically, you will:

• Own end-to-end technical direction for Session Replay, spanning frontend, backend, and data systems

• Drive the evolution of our backend architecture, including:

• Designing systems around columnar/analytical data storage for large-scale session data  

• Defining data models, ingestion pipelines, and query patterns

• Lead the design of investigation workflows, connecting replay with logs, metrics, traces and other telemetry across Grafana Cloud

• Make high-leverage architectural decisions that impact multiple teams and products

• Partner with teams across Grafana (Frontend Observability, Synthetic Monitoring, Core Grafana) to build cohesive cross-product experiences

• Engage directly with customers - joining calls, gathering structured feedback, and helping customers instrument and adopt Session Replay successfully. 

• Improve engineering standards, patterns, and operational practices

title: Candidature spontanée Eco-Compteur

🚲Chez Eco-Compteur, nous accompagnons les villes dans leur transition vers le développement des mobilités douces et aidons à la préservation des plus beaux sites naturels du monde !

Solutions qui vont des capteurs installés sur les pistes cyclables et les sentiers de randonnées aux logiciels d’interprétation des données. Parce que compter c’est bien mais donner du sens aux chiffres c’est encore mieux !

Vous aussi vous voulez avoir un impact dans la transformation des villes de demain et participer au développement du tourisme durable ? Nous sommes en recherche perpétuelle de nouveaux talents prêts à relever les défis de demain (Lannion, Rennes, Montreal, Düsseldorf ..) !
Vous êtes passionné.e par la randonnée, le vélo (d’ailleurs vous ne comptez même plus les kilomètres !) et les sports de pleine nature de manière générale, nos valeurs - autonomie, confiance & transparence - vous font écho, alors nous avons plus que hâte d'échanger avec vous ! 🚲

🌊 Des bureaux à 10 minutes de la Côte de Granit Rose : Une baignade entre 12h et 14h, une session paddle ou juste détente sur le sable !
🎉Une entreprise classée Great Place to Work 2022 (12ème au classement!) 2019 et 2017

title: Hadoop Big Data Developer
description:
Hadoop Big Data Developer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Hadoop Big Data Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000-$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 10+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced Hadoop Big Data Developer to design, build, and operate large-scale data processing pipelines and analytics platforms on Hadoop and related big-data ecosystems. In this role you will be responsible for ingesting, transforming, and analyzing massive volumes of structured and unstructured data to support enterprise analytics, machine learning, and reporting workloads. The ideal candidate will combine deep technical expertise across the Hadoop ecosystem with strong software engineering fundamentals and a clear understanding of how to deliver reliable, performant, and cost-effective data platforms in production environments.

• Strong hands-on expertise with Apache Spark (Scala, Python, or Java) in production environments.

• Solid experience with Hive, HDFS, Sqoop, HBase, and the broader Hadoop ecosystem.

• Hands-on experience with streaming data platforms such as Kafka, Spark Streaming, or Flink.

• Strong SQL skills and experience working with both relational and NoSQL data stores.

• Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow or Oozie.

• Solid understanding of distributed systems concepts, including partitioning, replication, and fault tolerance.

• Strong scripting skills in Python or Shell.

• Excellent troubleshooting, debugging, and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience operating Hadoop on cloud platforms such as AWS EMR, Azure HDInsight, or Databricks.

• Familiarity with modern lakehouse formats (Delta, Iceberg, Hudi).

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Simulation
description:

Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver-The World's Most Experienced Driver™-to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The Simulator team builds state-of-the-art simulations of realistic environments for the testing and training of the Waymo driver. We use machine learning to model the real world, including realistic agents (vehicles, pedestrians, cyclists, motorcyclists etc.), roads, traffic control systems, and weather. To increase the fidelity and steerability of the simulations, we employ large foundation models, trained on our massive datasets that allow us to quickly setup and rollout multiple scenarios to subject our driver to.

Company - Zero To One Strategic

Location - Remote, Canada-based

Position Type - Full-time

Start date - Immediate

Salary - $75,000 - $80,000 / yr

About Us

Zero To One Strategic is a specialized consultancy that helps innovative companies maximize revenue from Canadian R&D and innovation programs. We work with startups and scale-ups across multiple sectors and take a long-term, outcomes-driven approach to non-dilutive funding, including grants, subsidies, and tax credits.

The Grants team works closely with founders and technical leaders to design and execute integrated funding strategies that support R&D, commercialization, and scale. We support clients end-to-end, from identifying and matching to the right funding opportunities, through grant writing and submission, to post-award support, delivering a well-rounded, non-dilutive funding experience.

We operate in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and are passionate about supporting Canadian innovation and entrepreneurship. Our team works across disciplines and in close partnership with founders to help translate key milestones, technical ideas, and growth plans into funded, scalable outcomes. We look for team members who are equally excited to work alongside founders to help bring ambitious ideas to life.

Position Overview

We are looking for a Grants Specialist to manage and execute grant strategies across a large portfolio of active clients. This role is focused on client management, opportunity oversight, and ownership of funding outcomes, rather than grant writing alone.

You will be responsible for managing 50+ client accounts, staying ahead of new and existing funding opportunities, coordinating contractors and internal resources, communicating with funding agencies, reviewing and editing submissions, and ensuring applications are delivered on time and to a high standard.

This is an integral role on our Grants team and is well-suited to someone who is highly organized, tech-savvy, comfortable operating at scale, and confident managing multiple stakeholders simultaneously.

Key Responsibilities

Client / Portfolio Management

• Own a portfolio of 50+ active clients with ongoing grant strategies

• Serve as the primary point of coordination for grant related work

• Work directly with founders and their leadership teams to translate business priorities, projects, and technical roadmaps into fundable grant strategies

• Ensure clients are informed of relevant opportunities and timelines

• Manage active, submitted, and awarded opportunities through to final outcome & reporting

Grants Opportunity Management

• Monitor federal and provincial funding programs relevant to assigned clients

• Assess eligibility, effort, timing, and likelihood of success

• Advise clients on which opportunities to pursue or deprioritize based on eligibility, past success, etc.

• Maintain visibility across the full grants pipeline for each client

• Proactively flag risks, dependencies, and resourcing needs

Contractor and Workflow Management

• Coordinate internal and external grant writers and subject matter experts

• Provide clear briefs, context, and deadlines

• Review, edit, and quality check all submissions before final delivery

• Ensure alignment with client positioning and funder requirements

• Collaborate closely with Customer Success, SR&ED, and other internal teams to ensure a well-rounded, client-first funding experience.

Writing Support

• Contribute to writing full applications, where appropriate

• Edit and strengthen drafts written by others for QC, clarity, compliance, and impact

• Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Claude to support research and drafting with strong human oversight

Process, Documentation, and Follow Up

• Track deadlines, submission status, and outcomes across your portfolio

As a Threat Investigator , you will be supporting our Investigations Team and responsible for detecting and/or responding to malicious uses and abuse, investigating the activity, drafting reports based on your findings, and making recommendations. This will require technical experience investigating threat actors, harmful behaviors, and/or other activities; as well as a strong ability to use SQL and Python to query, transform, and understand data. You will also respond to escalations and reactive leads, including those that are not caught by our existing safety systems.
Investigations involve sensitive and distressing content, including sexual, violent, or otherwise-disturbing material.
This role includes serving in an on-call capacity that will involve resolving urgent escalations outside of normal work hours, occasionally including evenings and weekends. The typical on-call rotation is 7 consecutive days per 2 months, though this may shift based on operational needs and candidates should be prepared to remain flexible.
This is a remote, full-time position.
In this role, you will:

• Proactively detect and reacquire bad actors on our platform.

• Investigate potentially policy-violating activity by querying internal data sources (using SQL and Python) and cross-referencing open source information (OSINT).

• Document and share investigative findings with internal stakeholders.

Requirements:

• At least 3+ years of related investigative experience in Trust & Safety, National Security, Defense, Intelligence, or Law Enforcement domains working on related topics; must be willing to work on sensitive subject matter including child safety.

• U.S.-based, with the ability to work West Coast hours (9am - 5pm PT).

• Ability to be on-call that will involve resolving urgent escalations outside of normal work hours, including occasional evenings and weekends.

• Strong SQL and Python proficiency and/or additional programming skills.

• Strong and applicable technical investigative skillset with ability to develop and maintain detection pipelines.

• Ability to rapidly context switch across domains, modalities, and abuse areas.

• Excited to work in a fast paced, ambiguous, and purposeful space with high impact across users and beyond.

Preferred Qualities (but not required):

• Expertise with risk and abuse related to AI platforms.

• Full professional proficiency in Arabic, Chinese, Farsi, Portuguese, Russian, or Spanish.

• Have experience scaling and automating detection and mitigation processes.

title: Prototype Manufacturing Engineer, Mechanical & Fluid Systems
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's Air Dominance & Strike (AD&S) Manufacturing Engineering team is seeking a Prototype Manufacturing Engineer to execute first builds and prototype manufacturing across our mechanical, structural, thermal management, and fluid systems (fuel, hydraulics, pneumatics) subsystems. This role spans the full AD&S portfolio of autonomous aircraft, cruise missiles, and loitering munitions - and is designed for an engineer who thrives in ambiguity, builds hardware with incomplete inputs, and treats every first build as an opportunity to generate the manufacturing knowledge that makes future production possible.

As a Prototype ME, you are the first manufacturing engineer on a new build. You will work from incomplete design definitions - often without released drawings or established work instructions - to figure out how hardware goes together, build the first units, and document what you learn. Your output is not just a built prototype; it is the MVP work instructions, preliminary BOM structure, buildability feedback, and lessons learned that the DFx and SME teams use to drive producibility improvements and prepare for rate production. You are the bridge between a design engineer's intent and the physical reality of how something gets built for the first time.

This is a cross-program role. You will move between AD&S programs based on where first builds are happening, bringing a consistent methodology to new hardware regardless of the product line. You will work closely with design engineers, DFx engineers, SME manufacturing engineers, and production technicians. The pace is fast, the inputs are messy, and the expectation is that you bring order to chaos - one build at a time.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Execute first builds of new mechanical, structural, thermal, and fluid system hardware across AD&S programs, working from preliminary or incomplete design inputs (unreleased models, draft drawings, verbal direction from design engineers).

• Develop MVP work instructions during and immediately after first builds - capturing assembly sequences, tooling needs, critical dimensions, torque values, and process notes sufficient for a technician to repeat the build.

• Establish preliminary BOM structures (Make/Buy determinations) based on first-build experience, identifying which components should be fabricated internally, procured, or sent to contract manufacturers.

• Provide structured design feedback to design engineers based on first-build observations - specifically addressing buildability, checkability (can you inspect it?), and repeatability (can someone else build it the same way?).

• Document lessons learned from every first build and feed them directly to DFx engineers for incorporation into formal DFM/DFA reviews and design trade studies.

• Build and support Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) units - Ironbirds, Copperbirds, and similar integration test articles - where the build method is undefined and must be figured out from scratch.

• Identify and resolve manufacturing issues in real time on the shop floor during first builds, including fit/interference problems, fastener access issues, routing conflicts, and assembly sequence challenges.

title: Senior Product Manager (Licensing & Billing)
description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

- Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

- Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

- Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation

That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register http://app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Your main goal will be to make it simple and reliable for customers to buy, pay for, and grow their use of n8n. You'll own the foundations of how n8n's commercial system works: licensing and entitlements, customer accounts, and the metering and billing platform for both Cloud and Enterprise. Today these live across several teams and two billing stacks; you'll bring them into one stable home that the rest of the company builds on.

This is a foundations role. You build the system that pricing and packaging decisions run on, rather than running price experiments yourself. To do so, here are your core responsibilities:

OWN THE LICENSING & BILLING STRATEGY & ROADMAP

- Define and communicate the product strategy and roadmap for Licensing & Billing in partnership with Engineering, Product leadership, Finance, and go-to-market.

- Prioritize foundational investments based on revenue integrity, enterprise needs, data correctness, and engineering effort, and make trade-offs explicit.

- Lead discovery with enterprise customers, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and RevOps to understand how n8n is bought, renewed, and grown today, and where that breaks.

LICENSING, ENTITLEMENTS & ACCOUNTS

- Own the license server and entitlement model: issuance, renewal, and validation across Cloud, self-hosted, air-gapped, and OEM deployments, with one source of truth for which plan or deal grants which features.

- Introduce "account" as a first-class product primitive (accounts, purchases, license keys, activations) and expose it as the API contract our customer-facing console and multi-instance management are built on.

- Productize the deal-to-entitlement flow so a closed deal in Salesforce creates or updates entitlements without manual steps.

METERING & BILLING PLATFORM

- Own usage metering and billing for Cloud and Enterprise, including subscription billing: what counts as a billable execution, quota consumption, and overage charging.

- Lead the migration off Paddle Classic and unify Cloud and Enterprise billing into one platform.

- Build the mechanics for usage-based enterprise billing and reliable overage charging.

CROSS-ORG ALIGNMENT

- Make the architecture and mechanism decisions (entitlement model, billing platform, enterprise invoicing path) and align closely with Finance and go-to-market on each of them. Every decision here touches money; you bring people along rather than inform them afterwards.

- Hold clear boundaries with adjacent teams: the customer console, execution limits, and access control live elsewhere; you own the data and mechanics they rely on.

- Establish clear success measures and keep the squad accountable for outcomes, not only delivery.

description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a generalist senior full-stack product engineer to join our early team in New York City. You’ll work closely with product, design and the rest of engineering to ship features end to end across the Starbridge platform, from the data model and APIs through to the UI. You’ll create the foundations that let us iterate quickly on customer feedback.

You might be a fit if you:

- Have 5+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production web applications across frontend and backend.

- Have experience working in a startup or a smaller company with real engineering impact.

- Have strong experience with React, TypeScript and modern frontend tooling.

- Are comfortable in a work environment that blends sync and async communication and work.

Preferably, you also have experience with at least some of the following:

- Experience as a technical lead making architectural design decisions.

- Github CI/CD.

- Cloud infrastructure, ideally GCP.

- Building product features on top of LLMs.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

We move fast - really fast. Getting back to someone today beats tomorrow, and our interview process reflects that mindset. Please keep us posted on your timeline so we can move quickly and speed things up where needed.

After submitting your application, the team reviews your CV and statement of exceptional work. If your application passes this stage, you will be invited to a 30-minute interview during which a member of our team will make sure you're a good fit for the role. You will have the opportunity ask questions and learn more about the role as well.

We'll then send you a programming challenge that consists of two parts: LeetCode and React. Beyond that step, you will enter the main process, which consists of three interviews:

1. Experience, theory, and system design.

2. Live coding.

3. Product thinking and past work.

Our goal is to finish the process within one week. All interviews will be conducted via Google Meet.

HOW WE WORK

- Build Bridges to Help Customers Win - We pride ourselves on being obsessively customer-centric.

- Shooting Star Speed - We move with extreme speed. We value momentum, decisiveness, and the ability to accelerate when it matters.

- Fun Is a Feature - Fun is a Feature means we intentionally design Starbridge to be an energizing place to do hard work. Joy, humor, and camaraderie make great teams faster, sharper, and more resilient.

- In the Arena - We believe the best ideas come from living close to the work, feeling the friction, hearing the nuance, and experiencing the details firsthand.

BENEFITS INCLUDE:

- Competitive salary + early-stage equity

- Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance

- Company provided lunch in office everyday

- 75% coverage of Chelsea Piers Fitness membership

- Unlimited PTO

- Regular offsites (NYC + global locations)

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
About the team
The Public Cloud Foundations (PCF) team is part of Platform Engineering. We build the internal cloud platform that every Zillow engineer builds on: the self-service APIs, paved paths, and automation that turn the raw complexity of AWS into a small set of safe, reliable, well-documented product surfaces.

We treat the platform as a product. Rather than handling cloud infrastructure as a queue of tickets and one-off requests, we design software that lets teams provision accounts, networking, and shared infrastructure themselves, safe by default. Our current work shows the direction: self-service VPC connectivity, a Terraform delivery platform, container base images delivered as a managed product, and provisioning and policy capabilities exposed as APIs instead of runbooks. We partner closely with Runtime Platform, Database Engineering, Middleware Engineering, Delivery Engineering, and Security to replace manual cloud work with software.

PCF is where you help decide how Zillow uses the public cloud, and how a platform team turns operational surface area into engineered products. About the role
As a Senior Software Development Engineer on Public Cloud Foundations, you will build the services and APIs that abstract away the complexity of the public cloud, and own them as products from design through operation.
In this role, you will:

• Design, build, and own backend services and APIs that make cloud capabilities self-service: account provisioning, networking, IAM, and policy exposed as clean software interfaces rather than tickets or manual processes.

• Turn recurring cloud work into products. Take patterns that today depend on human judgment or hand-run runbooks and encode them into APIs, controls, and automation that are safe by default.

• Treat teams across Zillow as the customers of your platform: understand their use cases, shape the interfaces and paved paths they build on, and let their feedback and usage data drive your roadmap.

• Own the reliability of what you build. Design for observability, SLOs, and self-healing so the platform runs itself. Like any team that owns services in production, you'll be on call for what you ship, and you'll lead the follow-up work that removes whole classes of problems rather than patching individual incidents.

• Use modern AI-assisted and agentic tooling to accelerate design, implementation, and operations while keeping quality and safety high.

• Influence how Platform Engineering approaches public cloud enablement, bringing a product mindset to design discussions and roadmap decisions.

You'll help take a set of foundational capabilities and turn them into a cohesive, self-service platform that Zillow engineers experience as a product, not a queue.

title: Data Analyst (Strategic Projects)
description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

- One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re building the most advanced, data-driven operating model in fintech. As part of Lendable’s Operations Science & Strategy team, you’ll sit at the intersection of analytics, data science, and AI engineering - using data, LLMs, and automation to transform how our Operations teams work at scale.

You’ll work directly with senior operations leadership working on special projects to diagnose demand drivers, uncover commercial opportunities, build KPI frameworks, and deploy automation that materially reduces our cost-to-serve while improving customer outcomes.

If you’re technical, curious, and love owning problems end-to-end, this is the role for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

1. AUTOMATION & AI ENGINEERING

- Use Python and LLM APIs (e.g. OpenAI) to design and deploy automation that replaces manual CS/FS processes.

- Build prototypes, test with real operations data, and scale the successful ones into production workflows.

- Partner with PMs and engineers to operationalise AI-driven solutions across Operations.

2. DEMAND ANALYTICS & STRATEGY

- Analyse key operations demand drivers (contact per customer, reason drivers, seasonality, servicing behaviour).

- Identify levers to reduce avoidable demand and improve customer outcomes.

- Build analytical models that drive decision-making around cost optimisation and resourcing.

3. KPI & FUNNEL INTELLIGENCE

- Build clear, robust KPI frameworks and funnel views across customer journeys.

- Translate data into commercial insight, operational efficiency recommendations, and productivity tracking.

- Create metrics that scale across new geographies, products, and teams.

4. WORK WITH SENIOR LEADERSHIP

- Work directly with Ops Directors, Heads of CS/FS/Fraud/Complaints, and the COO on strategic initiatives.

- Turn raw data into narrative-driven recommendations that are simple, actionable, and commercially grounded.

- Own analytics for high-impact projects end-to-end.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

MUST-HAVE SKILLS

- 2-3 years of hands-on experience using Python in a professional setting.

- Highly numerate with strong analytical reasoning

- Ability to independently structure analysis, build prototypes, and deliver insights.

- Experience communicating data-driven recommendations to non-technical business stakeholders.

NICE-TO-HAVES

- STEM Degree

- Experience with dbt or modern data stacks.

- Familiarity with LLMs, APIs, or interest in building AI automation.

- Exposure to product, strategy, or operations environments.

- Thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments

tags: Génie des procédés, système de production et fabrication avancée
description:
ENGLISH VERSION

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.
Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.
L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École.
Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques.
Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret.

Vous rêvez d’une industrie propre, efficace et durable ? Le centre SPIN en fait sa priorité.
Énergie, environnement, procédés industriels… on y conçoit des systèmes pour produire mieux, avec moins.
L’objectif ? Limiter l’impact environnemental, réduire la consommation énergétique et booster l’efficacité.
🔧 Dans un monde en pleine mutation, nos équipes déploient leur créativité scientifique pour accompagner l’ industrie du futur.
Et vous, prêt·e à innover à nos côtés ?

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que doctorant, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions de recherche et innovation et, dans une moindre mesure de nos missions d’enseignement. Vous serez affecté au centre SPIN - LGF (Laboratoire Georges Friedel, UMR CNRS 5307). Au sein de ce centre, vous conjuguez passion scientifique et impact sociétal.
Le centre SPIN (Science des Procédés Industriels et Naturels), qui sera fortement impliqué dans la thèse, développe, au sein de Mines Saint-Etienne, son expertise dans le domaine du Génie des Procédés appliqué aux systèmes dispersés : grains, particules, gouttes, bulles, milieux poreux. Il possède également des compétences en développement de capteurs et d’instrumentation.
Les technologies de captage et stockage du CO2 sont des technologies clés pour la décarbonation du secteur industriel. Les stockages offshores ont déjà démontré leur faisabilité, mais les stockages onshores semblent nécessaires pour augmenter les capacités de stockage tout en réduisant le transport de CO2. Or, la proximité de ces sites avec les populations rend leurs déploiements incertains et soulève des questions relatives à l’acceptabilité sociale.
La surveillance à long terme des sites de stockage de CO2, exigée par la directive européenne CCS, constitue une opportunité pour renforcer la transparence et l’acceptation locale du stockage en engageant les parties prenantes dans l’acquisition et l’interprétation des données. Cependant, les systèmes actuels de surveillance ne permettent pas à la fois de réaliser des mesures in-situ, simulations numériques et visualisation interactive pour une approche du suivi intégrée des sites de stockage. Le projet CO2MET vise à développer et faire progresser des unités ou éléments clés pour préparer un futur système intégré de surveillance numérique à long terme améliorant la fiabilité et l’acceptabilité du stockage géologique de CO2.
Pour atteindre ces objectifs, le consortium CO2MET a été constitué et est composé de l'IFPEN,

Sa stratégie 2023-2027 vise à accompagner les transitions écologique, numérique et générationnelle, tout en contribuant à la souveraineté nationale et européenne en microélectronique et numérique. Le campus Aix-Marseille-Provence, situé à Gardanne, regroupe le Centre Microélectronique de Provence (CMP), des formations d’ingénieurs et de masters, un incubateur technologique et des plateformes de prototypage. Il accueille environ 400 étudiants et 200 personnels de Mines Saint-Étienne et d’entreprises partenaires. Le CMP dispose d’une salle blanche de 700 m², équipée d’une centaine d’équipements scientifiques répartis en zones de classes 100, 1 000 et 10 000. Cette plateforme est utilisée par les équipes de recherche, les membres académiques et industriels de l’association Micro-PackS, ainsi que pour les formations initiales et continues. Ses activités couvrent notamment les procédés de couches minces, la photolithographie, la chimie, la caractérisation physique et électrique des matériaux et dispositifs, le micropackaging, l’électronique imprimée et la préparation d’échantillons. 🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

We aim to develop and deploy critically needed capabilities that address our customers’ most pressing national security requirements. As the Production Test Engineering Manager , your role encompasses the strategic oversight and tactical management of production systems to support high-volume products across the portfolio. You are charged with ensuring rigorous testing protocols are in place, resulting in the consistent delivery of superior quality products to our customers. Furthermore, your leadership guarantees the fulfillment of manufacturing's test throughput requirements. This position demands an innovative approach to resolving complex testing challenges, advancing scalability, and enhancing our automation, throughput, user interfaces, and data analytics methodologies.

• Lead the procurement and implementation of new test equipment, performing cost-benefit and ROI analyses as needed.

• Champion initiatives that enhance safety, reduce costs, improve quality, and increase productivity through testing.

• Cultivate a culture focused on innovation, collaboration, and accountability in the engineering department.

• Act as the go-to technical authority for manufacturing test matters, advising on and troubleshooting complex issues.

• Design proactive maintenance and calibration protocols for manufacturing test equipment.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 8+ years of relevant industry experience with emphasis on manufacturing test and product sustainment.

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Electronics, Computer, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.

• Minimum of 2+ years as a people manager leading manufacturing test engineering or relevant adjacent fields.

• Experienced in Linux, C#, Python, NixOS, LabView, or other forms of test automation.

• Experience with computer hardware communication protocols: USB, Ethernet, RS232, RS485, PCIe, HDMI, CAN, etc.

title: Lead Security Engineer - GRC
description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Lead Security Engineer you will be a senior technical and risk reference who moves where the risk is, across TPRM, Security Awareness and Cyber Risk, rather than owning a single silo. You will assess security gaps across diverse technologies, third parties and business contexts, quantify what matters, and turn it into prioritized, actionable treatment plans that leadership can decide on.

You will build and evolve the policies, methodologies, platforms and automation behind these programs, and help the squad scale across Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, and other geos without scaling headcount linearly. You will partner with Engineering, Product, Legal, Procurement, Operations, Internal Communication, Risk teams and the business stakeholders to translate requirements into clear, pragmatic technical specifications. This is a multidisciplinary and global role, working with teams primarily based in Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, and the United States.

YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

- Assess security gaps across business processes and technologies, enable effective risk treatment, and define remediation plans with clear owners and deadlines.

- Work closely with ITSec, Risk, Procurement stakeholders to align on mitigation of identified risks and on risk acceptance decisions.

- Lead the evolution of the TPRM program toward a risk-based, lifecycle model: onboarding, continuous monitoring, offboarding, and fourth-party visibility.

- Define/review security requirements for third parties, including contractual security clauses and annexes, and guide business owners on their application.

- Build and scale automation and AI-assisted assessment capabilities that reduce manual questionnaire effort and increase coverage.

- Report third-party risk posture and trends to leadership and relevant committees.

- Drive human risk programs through phishing simulations, training and communication and evaluate and evolve the tooling behind them (build versus buy).

- Define and track behavior-change metrics that go beyond completion rates, and report them through dashboards for management.

- Act as technical lead across the squad, raising the technical and analytical bar and fostering continuous improvement.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR A PERSON WHO HAS

- Proven experience designing and implementing security controls and leading risk management initiatives, with strong knowledge of domains and concepts of cyber risks.

- Hands-on experience with risk analysis techniques: risk identification, assessment and prioritization, using both qualitative and quantitative methods.

- Experience with TPRM (third-party risk management).

- Experience building or running security awareness and human-risk programs, or a strong ability to ramp up on them quickly.

- Experience with large-scale distributed environments and cloud environments (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure).

- Familiarity with frameworks such as NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-30, ISO 27001/27002/27005, ISO 31000, PCI-DSS, ITIL, COBIT and similar.

- Excellent executive communication skills, able to translate complex topics into clear, actionable insights for senior leadership and committees.

- Technical background and comfort with automation, scripting and AI or LLM-based tooling to scale security processes.

- Experience operating in regulated and global environments, including interaction with auditors and regulators.

- Proven ability to lead projects and process improvement initiatives

title: Staff DevOps Engineer
description:
About Terawatt Infrastructure
The once in a century transition to autonomous and electric vehicles is underway and will require a multi-trillion-dollar investment in energy and charging infrastructure, and the real estate to site it on. Terawatt is the leader in delivering large scale, turnkey charging solutions for companies rapidly deploying AV and EV fleets. Whether it’s an urban mobility hub, or a carefully located multi-fleet hub for semi-trucks, Terawatt brings the talent, capabilities, and capital to create reliable, cost-effective solutions for customers on the leading edge of the transition to the next generation of transport.
With a growing portfolio of sites across the US in urban hubs and along key logistics and transportation corridors. Terawatt is building the permanent transportation and logistics infrastructure of tomorrow through a robust combination of capital, real estate, development, and site operations solutions. The company develops, finances, owns, and operates charging solutions that take the cost and complexity out of electrifying fleets. 
Our Values
Six core values guide how we work: commitments we make to each other. Our pace is set by a simple conviction: imperfect action beats perfect inaction, so we move with purpose, adapt without ego, and measure ourselves by progress rather than activity. Ownership travels with autonomy. Your name is on the work, and the best answer wins the conversation, wherever it lives. That candor works because of what surrounds it: people who show up with intention and have each other's back, tough on ideas and generous with people. Our customers feel this as reliability earned daily, every interaction treated as a chance to build something lasting. And underneath it all is why the work matters. The climate doesn't wait, and the stakes are also human: behind every checklist and every inspection is a person going home safely. We call it "This work has a heartbeat” - it's what the other five rest on.
Our Technology
Terawatt is not a traditional infrastructure operator. Our technology platform transforms a portfolio of sites into a reliable, intelligent network - through advanced power management, operational optimization, and data-driven systems that back our customers with hard performance guarantees. That's what makes us a de-risked operator and a category-defining company.
We sit at a rare intersection: software, hardware, real estate, energy systems, and live site operations. The work is concrete and the stakes are real. The code you write today runs physical infrastructure tomorrow. You'll build systems that orchestrate megawatts of power across hundreds of chargers, ingest millions of telemetry events per day, and keep autonomous fleets, rideshare vehicles, and heavy-duty trucks moving - in real time.

Compensation for this role is determined by several factors, including the cost of labor in specific geographic markets, and these ranges are intended to provide a helpful reference. The actual compensation offer will be based on the candidate’s location, skills, level of expertise and experience, and internal equity considerations. In addition to base salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package and, where applicable, performance-based incentives.

We are building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. At Terawatt, we continuously strive to foster inclusion, humility, energizing relationships, and belonging, and welcome new ideas. We're growing and want you to grow with us. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.
If a reasonable accommodation is required to fully participate in the job application or interview process, or to perform the essential functions of the position, please contact people@terawattinfrastructure.com.
 
Terawatt Infrastructure is an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) Care Coordinator
description:
About the Role
A US-based medical practice specializing in sleep medicine is seeking an experienced Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) Care Coordinator to support patients on CPAP therapy. This role is central to the practice's remote monitoring program: you will review patient data daily, conduct outbound calls to patients who need encouragement or troubleshooting, document interactions accurately for billing compliance, and coordinate with the clinical and DME teams to ensure patients remain on therapy and progressing well.
This is a clinically adjacent role that requires a warm phone presence, strong organizational habits, and comfort working with data in a remote monitoring platform. A clinical background - nursing, medical assisting, respiratory therapy, or similar - is preferred and carries weight for billing purposes as well as patient care quality. Training will be provided on all internal workflows. The practice is looking for a coordinator who can be ready to contribute by November 1, 2026.
Key Responsibilities
Daily Data Review and Patient Flagging

• Review patients' CPAP usage data in Sanusom daily, including usage hours, mask leak rates, AHI scores, and missed nights

• Identify patients who fall below therapy thresholds or show concerning trends and prioritize them for outreach

• Download compliance reports, upload them to the appropriate patient chart in Athena, and assign them to the correct provider for review
Patient Outreach and Coaching

• Conduct outbound calls to patients with low usage, elevated mask leaks, or other therapy concerns, using established call scripts and intervention protocols

• Troubleshoot common CPAP issues including mask fit problems, pressure discomfort, dry mouth, and air leaks, and guide patients toward solutions

• Encourage and motivate patients to remain on therapy in a warm, supportive manner - the goal is to help patients succeed, not to pressure them

• Handle a daily outbound call volume of approximately 60 patient calls

• Schedule follow-up calls and ensure no patient is lost to follow-up
Documentation and Billing Support

• Use Sanusom's call timer to record monitoring time accurately for each patient interaction, in compliance with RPM billing requirements

• Document every call in both Sanusom and Athena using standard clinical templates, ensuring records are complete, timely, and accurate

• Respond to patient messages via Klara within established response time standards
Care Coordination

• Coordinate with the DME and CPAP supply team on mask refits, equipment issues, and supply needs identified during patient calls

• Coordinate with scheduling for follow-up provider appointments when clinically indicated

• Escalate clinical concerns to the provider promptly and in accordance with established protocols
Systems
The practice uses Sanusom (remote monitoring platform), Athena (EHR), and Klara (patient messaging). Full training on internal workflows will be provided. Prior experience with RPM, RTM, or CPAP compliance platforms is a strong advantage.
Qualifications
Required

• Minimum 1 year of experience in remote patient monitoring, chronic care management, or patient outreach - ideally with sleep medicine, CPAP therapy, or DME patients

• Solid understanding of CPAP therapy, including common patient challenges such as mask fit issues, pressure intolerance, dry mouth, and air leaks

• Warm, patient, and encouraging phone presence - you know how to motivate a patient who is struggling without making them feel pressured or judged

• Organized and detail-oriented, with a consistent habit of accurate and timely documentation

• Comfortable reviewing data dashboards and identifying patients who need follow-up based on usage trends

• Strong understanding of HIPAA and patient confidentiality requirements, particularly in a remote work environment

• Reliable high-speed internet connection and a quiet, private workspace suitable for clinical patient calls

title: Account Executive 4
description:
Who we are

At Twilio , we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilio ns!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio ’s next New Business Account Executive 4 on our High Tech team!
About the job
This position is needed to lead prospecting, solution selling and closing new business opportunities across our Messaging, Voice and Email products. In this role, you will be directly responsible for expanding our messaging business with some of the largest and fastest growing mid-market and enterprise companies in the High Tech vertical. New Business Account Executives are experts in the CPaaS ecosystem and Twilio ’s product offerings. This role is highly cross functional, with deep integration with product management, carrier relations, finance, and solutions engineering teams.
Responsibilities
In this role, you’ll:

• Drive new customer acquisition, while being assigned a quota for iACV (incremental Account Contract Value)

• Own highly analytical and consultative sales cycles to win business in competitive vendor sourcing cycles with Twilio ’s messaging (e.g. SMS, MMS, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Google Business Messages, Account Security, etc.), voice and email solutions.

• Work with customers across assigned verticals (Financial Services) to understand their business and technical requirements, and match them to the capabilities of Twilio ’s communications API platform, designing a solution for their specific use cases.

• Work with teams in Finance, Legal, Pricing, and Operations to design mutually beneficial contracts to address customer requirements, while balancing the needs of our business.

• Be passionate about what you do, think outside the box, and use world-class interpersonal and communication skills to present complex contractual, technical, and financial details to prospects in a way that builds confidence and comfort in the proposed solution.

• Balance competing priorities and manage multiple projects and deals at the same time.

• Partner cross functionally with sales, services, product, and finance to develop long range territory strategies and sales plans.

• Act as the voice of the customer to Twilio ’s product and carrier relations teams.

• Demonstrate a strong understanding of the CPaaS industry - staying up to date on key industry initiatives and new capabilities - on behalf of your customers and the wider Twilio go-to-market organization.

• Generate and maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast utilizing our CRM, Salesforce.

• Stay current with industry changes and collaborate with your team and peers to learn and share best practices

Qualifications
Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio . We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

description:
Job Title: Network Engineer II

Department: DCT Infrastructure

Reports to: Senior Director of Infrastructure

Employment Status: Exempt/Fulltime

Location: Remote

Travel - 30-40%

About Applied Digital :

At Applied Digital , we are the epicenter of AI innovation, crafting cutting-edge data center solutions tailored for the demands of high-performance computing. Designed from the ground up to support AI and machine learning workloads, our infrastructure is the backbone of tomorrow’s technological advancements, including AI-driven video and generative platforms.

We are:

• Forward-Thinkers: With a keen eye on current market trends and future innovations, we adapt swiftly and lead technological evolution.

• Resilient: We navigate complex challenges and emerge stronger, delivering robust and reliable solutions for industry pioneers.

• Innovative Designers: Leveraging the latest technologies, we create visionary solutions that redefine industry standards.

At Applied Digital , we are committed to solving intricate problems, advancing business initiatives, maximizing operational efficiency, and reducing our carbon footprint. We are a team of resilient, forward-thinking innovators driving the AI revolution.

Position Summary:

We are seeking a skilled Enterprise Network Engineer II with professional-level knowledge (JNCIP-ENT, CCNP, or equivalent experience) to join our infrastructure team. This role requires a candidate that is willing to travel and have expertise in enterprise network operations, implementation, and support. The ideal candidate will bring firsthand experience with routing protocols, switching, firewalls, and a desire to grow their skills in network automation and advanced technologies.

Key Responsibilities:

• Implement and maintain routing protocols including OSPF, BGP, and ISIS across the enterprise network

• Configure and support multi-vendor firewall platforms including Juniper and Fortinet.

• Deploy and manage Routing & Switching infrastructure from vendors including Juniper and Cisco

• Install, configure, and troubleshoot enterprise wireless networks to ensure reliable, secure Wi-Fi coverage for all users

• Troubleshoot network issues and collaborate with senior engineers to resolve complex problems

• Assist in the development and implementation of network automation

• Perform network changes following established change management procedures

• Monitor network performance and proactively identify potential issues

• Maintain accurate network documentation including diagrams, configurations, and procedures

• Participating in network projects and technology refresh initiatives

• Provide support during on-call rotation for critical infrastructure and occasional off-hours maintenance windows

Basic Qualifications:

• JNCIP-ENT, CCNP, or equivalent professional-level certification, or demonstrable equivalent knowledge and experience at that level

• 5-7 years of firsthand experience implementing and supporting enterprise networks

• Solid understanding of OSPF, BGP, and ISIS routing protocols

• Experience configuring and troubleshooting enterprise firewalls (Juniper SRX, Fortinet)

• Working knowledge of switching technologies including MP-BGP EVPN, VXLAN, VLANs, spanning tree, and link aggregation

• Experience supporting enterprise Wi-Fi networks, with working knowledge of wireless standards, security protocols, and networking fundamentals.

• Experience with network monitoring and troubleshooting tools

• Strong analytical and critical thinking skills

• Strong work ethic

• Effective communication skills and ability to work effectively in a team environment

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with Juniper and Cisco

• JNCIA, JNCIS-ENT, JNCIP-ENT

• Familiarity with network automation tools such as Mist, AWX, Python, Ansible, Security Director Cloud.

• Knowledge of SD-WAN technologies

• Experience with cloud networking (AWS, Azure, GCP)

• Understanding of data center networking concepts

title: Principal, Business Operations
description:

As Principal, Business Operations at Greenbox Capital , you will help define how the company operates, scales, and makes decisions.
You will transform ambiguous business problems into clear workflows, operating models, business rules, implementation requirements, and measurable operating outcomes across underwriting, renewals, funding, servicing, sales, risk, product, data, and technology.
This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who can move from diagnosis through implementation. You will identify operational friction, design future-state processes, align cross-functional stakeholders, support rollout and adoption, and measure whether the change deliveredmeaningful business impact.
AI and automation may be used where appropriate, but they are not the identity of the role. The core focus is business-process transformation, adoption, and measurable improvement.

• Lead workflow redesign from initial diagnosis through pilot, rollout, adoption, and measurement.

• Build alignment across executives, frontline teams, and Product, Technology, Data, Engineering, and Operations.

title: Performance Creative Strategist, SeroVital
description:
About SeroVital
SeroVital is a leading anti-aging brand from Basic Research , backed by clinical research and trusted by millions of women. Our portfolio includes SeroVital ADVANCED, Hair Regeneres ADVANCED, Slim Sips, SeroVital Smile, and more, sold DTC, on Amazon, and at major retailers.
About the Role
We're looking for a sharp, insight-driven Performance Creative Strategist to join the SeroVital team. This role sits at the intersection of creative thinking, performance data, and hands-on execution, and plays a key role in shaping how our paid media creative evolves and scales. The ideal candidate can read what's working in performance, translate it into compelling hooks and angles, and bring those ideas to life quickly, using AI tools, our in-house video editor, and our design and agency partners.
What You'll Do

• Create ads directly using AI image and video tools, from fast concept tests to polished statics and short-form video.

• Write short-form video scripts and scroll-stopping hooks for paid social, including UGC, creator-led, and voiceover formats.

• Work closely with our in-house video editor to concept, cut, and iterate on video ads, including new variants of top performers.

• Develop clear creative briefs for designers and agency partners, with concept, copy, visual direction, and messaging guardrails.

• Analyze creative performance to understand what's working and what isn't, and use those insights to decide which messages to scale, refine, or retire, and where new messaging should go next.

• Balance iteration and innovation, scaling winning concepts while introducing net-new angles to test.

• Keep creative production organized, with assets named correctly, tracked, and delivered on time.

• Stay current on the competitive and cultural landscape in anti-aging, beauty, and wellness to spot trends, gaps, and opportunities.

Who You Are

• 2+ years of experience developing performance-driven creative for paid media (Meta, TikTok, or similar).

• Hands-on with AI creative tools for image and video generation, and comfortable editing in CapCut or similar.

• Able to translate performance data into actionable creative insights and new messaging directions.

• A strong writer of hooks, scripts, and messaging angles that stop the scroll and drive action.

• Understand how creative impacts metrics like CTR, CPA, and conversion rate, and use those signals to guide iteration.

• A clear communicator who can brief designers, editors, and agencies so the work comes back right the first time.

• Organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple creative workstreams at once.
Genuinely interested in beauty, wellness, healthy aging, and performance marketing.
